steps.because: ONE MOTION, TWO EFFECTS, AND ONLY ONE OF THEM IS HERE. `EMISSION` is gated on `spare = not(moving)`, so a tick spent crossing a cell is a tick not spent shining and a body emits on 1 - \beta of its ticks - THE SAME IN EVERY DIRECTION, so that is how much the body sends and it is already in the mass, where `Continuum` puts it as `\paren{1 - \beta}\bar{m}_{x}`. WHAT IS DIRECTIONAL IS THE OTHER HALF: `MOVEMENT` gives one cell a tick, so a distance IS a time, and between two emissions a tick apart the body has closed \beta\cdot\hat{d} of the way to wherever the ray is going - they land that much closer together and what arrives per tick is the reciprocal. IT IS THE CLASSICAL DOPPLER FACTOR and nothing about waves or observers went into it. A body blocks the vacuum's making whether it moves or not, so this is on the meeting term and nowhere else
